name: Mini Mental Breakdown San Diego 2022
information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MiniMentalBreakdownSanDiego2022#21964-competitor-information) tab.
